dead-letter:q.title: Failed messages are dropped
dead-letter:q.message: Worker fails 100% of messages, and orders's dead-letter route doesn't take “Order”: messages that run out of deliveries (1) are lost.
dead-letter:q.rationale: A message that keeps failing is redelivered up to the broker's delivery limit, then goes to the broker's dead-letter route, or is dropped when there isn't one (or its filter doesn't take the message). A dead-letter queue keeps it to inspect and replay.

fix.label: Send every failed message to orders-dlq

no-reader:dlq.title: Dead letters pile up in orders-dlq
no-reader:dlq.message: Nothing in the diagram reads or alerts on orders-dlq: failed messages stay there until someone looks.
no-reader:dlq.rationale: A dead-letter queue has no automatic cleanup. Someone should be told when messages land there, and be able to replay them.

fix.label: Add a reader…
fix.choice: Pick what reads orders-dlq, then add it and connect dlq to it.
